reason: I'm already doing DMs by hand and it kind of works, and I can't justify another $147 a month until I land my next client. A card-required trial that turns into final payments on day 4 is a lot to risk when I'm busy with client work.
objection: No customer results published yet, so I'd be the guinea pig paying $147 a month, with payments final after day 4, on a tool that sends from my own Instagram. If it gets my account flagged, I lose my main client source.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from a coach like me, such as booked calls from a named customer, plus a free trial that needs no card or a refund window after billing starts.
